title: skFlux
description: A blazing-fast, non-blocking Skript addon for HTTP requests and deep JSON parsing, ensuring your Minecraft server stays at 20 TPS.
body:
🎯 What is SkFlux?
SkFlux allows you to:

🌐 Make HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) to any API
⚡ Handle responses asynchronously without blocking your server
📊 Parse complex JSON data with ease
🔒 Manage authentication headers and secure requests
🚀 Build powerful integrations (Discord webhooks, databases, external services)
